items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson was a full participant in Wednesday practice for the first time since his ankle injury, after missing three games.
items.why: First full practice since ankle sprain; expected to play vs Bills.
items.opportunity: Increased efficiency and volume for targets with healthy Lamar.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love returns to practice (limited) Wednesday after ankle issue.
items.why: Returned after missing time; projected to play vs Cowboys pending rest of week.
items.implication: Tentative starter/role; Allgeier DNP opens path.
items.opportunity: Carries and snaps rebound if cleared.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) listed as non-participant in Wednesday practice.
items.why: Shoulder injury from prior game; rest day possible but monitor.
items.implication: Watch Thursday/Friday; contingency for Montgomery/others if limited.
items.opportunity: If out or limited, elevated role for David Montgomery or backups.

items.text: Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) non-participant Wednesday after hurting ankle vs Packers.
items.why: Ankle injury; Campbell indicated likely sit Wed.
items.implication: Monitor rest of week; Jameson Williams upside if limited.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets shift to Jameson Williams if restricted.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase non-participant Wednesday due to ankle injury and rest (NIR).
items.implication: Likely precautionary; Tee Higgins/others benefit short-term if limited.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for Tee Higgins if Chase restricted.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle aggravated previous chest injury on reverse last week; status vs Chiefs TBD based on practice, DNP Wednesday.
items.implication: Risky; Courtland Sutton/others elevated if limited/out.
items.opportunity: Target share to Sutton/Mims if Waddle sits.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th in YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Excited for Doyle to cook with healthy Lamar.
items.why: Elite efficiency even without Lamar; full unlock incoming.
items.implication: WR1 upside spike with Jackson return.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) DNP Wednesday walkthrough but said hamstring 'came out great' and doesn't believe back keeps him out.
items.why: Re-aggravated hamstring + back tweak Monday; optimistic self-report.
items.implication: Risky RB2; limited snaps possible vs WAS. Dameon Pierce to IR removes handcuff.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, Blue or others but thin backfield.

items.text: Prefer sell Chris Olave over Jordyn Tyson; rather sell the unproven rookie.
items.why: Value on proven over unproven; sell high preference.

items.text: Keeping it open on Sam LaPorta; could be big day vs Vikings defense pressuring Goff.
items.why: Matchup with pressure creating TE opportunities.

items.text: Jadarian Price is back, but can you put him right back into fantasy lineup?
Time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman in DEN backfield per Silva/Levitan discussion on return.
items.implication: Waiver/add priority if available (not listed player).

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba ripping off 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies despite losing Kubiak, few threats, shaded coverage, and stadium knowing where ball goes.
items.why: Massive overperformance vs opportunity amid scheme/personnel challenges.

items.text: Lions full-PPR PPG: Goff QB2, Gibbs RB1 (3.9 clear of Walker), St. Brown WR4, LaPorta TE6, Jameson Williams WR24. Zero surprise given defense/schedule/talent.
